title: Frosty Hud
description: This adds a Blue gui (only hearts, hunger and xp bar with gradient for now).  It is a great fit to my other texture pack to combine if you like
body:
❄️ FrostyHUD
A clean, icy blue HUD reskin for Minecraft, replacing the default interface elements with a frosty aesthetic.

✨ What's Included
FrostyHUD retextures the core parts of your HUD to give everything a cool, blue feel. Your hearts get a full makeover — full, half, and container textures all restyled. The hunger bar follows suit, with all states including the hunger effect covered. The XP bar is replaced with a smooth blue gradient, and the crosshair is refreshed to match the overall theme.

📦 Details
Built for Minecraft 1.21.x (Pack Format 34) as a purely cosmetic resource pack focused on the HUD and GUI — no mods required.

🔗 More Packs

Want matching frosted item textures to go alongside this HUD? Check out Frosted Items — a pack that gives your weapons, tools, and equipment a full icy makeover using anvil renaming! https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/frosted-items Combined with this Texture Pack it will make your gameplay feel Frosted❄️
